refinement_plan_1.analysis: Review feedback indicates all CQs are fully covered and no constraint violations exist. Main improvement suggestions are: (1) introduce owl:equivalentClass axioms for classes like InvoiceMessage to define necessary and sufficient conditions, (2) add General Class Axioms (GCAs) for advanced business rules (e.g., Buyer role must have GLN identifier), (3) use owl:disjointUnionOf for InvoiceHeader, InvoiceDetail, InvoiceSummary, (4) enrich Address with optional region/state and contact properties. Priorities: 1) Add equivalentClass for InvoiceMessage; 2) Add at least one GCA for Buyer/GLN; 3) Add disjointUnionOf for invoice sections; 4) Add region/state/contact to Address. All changes must preserve existing correct elements and CQ coverage. No constraint violations to fix.
